title: Senior AI Engineer
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years taking ML and LLM systems from prototype to production, focused on LLM application design, prompt engineering and agent frameworks. Designs multi-agent architectures in LangGraph, RAG with embeddings, vector search and cross-encoder reranking, and document-extraction agents, backed by automated evaluation, tracing and observability. Builds reliable API-based services with FastAPI, Docker and Azure, and works with stakeholders to turn business problems into measurable results. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Enterprise Knowledge Retrieval Assistant
bullets: Built a multi-agent assistant that answers employee questions over enterprise documents, combining hybrid search, embeddings and cross-encoder reranking with citation grounding so every answer points to its source.
Evaluated faithfulness and citation accuracy with LLM evaluators and tracing, then served the agents through FastAPI on Azure with access-aware retrieval and audit logging.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior AI Engineer role in the Group AI engineering team at Columbus. As a Senior AI Engineer I design LangGraph multi-agent systems and RAG applications that run in production, with evaluation and tracing built in from the start. Most of my work comes back to one question: will this agent still behave well when real people rely on it?

Columbus helps companies move their core processes onto new technology, and the Group AI team is now building the agentic systems their people will work with every day. Being part of a small founding team, close to the decisions, is the work I want next. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Copenhagen together and settle there long term.

I would bring production experience in agents and retrieval. I built a multi-agent analytics chatbot in LangGraph that cut manual analysis by 98%, and evaluation and observability pipelines for question-answering and summary agents that reduced human review by 43%. I have also fine-tuned a cross-encoder to rerank dense search results, which is where much of RAG quality is won.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. Building for teachers who cannot afford a tool that misbehaves has made me careful about how AI reaches real users. I would be glad to talk about what I could build with the team.
